messages:
sarah_auditor: quick ask for SOC2 auditor: package showing RBAC changes (2025-02-10..2025-02-14), KMS decrypt events for alias/ci-encrypt, vuln triage notes for token-service, and a correlation map PR->CI->deploy->runbook. need an ETA and preferred artifact format.

laura_sec_eng: I can own RBAC artifacts. I'll export GH PR diffs, approval snapshots, and kubectl apply records. prefer a manifest.csv. ETA: redacted sample today, full bundle tomorrow EOD.

mike_platform: I'll export CloudTrail & Splunk decrypt events. Splunk query i'll use:
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) "kms:keyId"="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345" | table _time,eventName,userIdentity.arn,sourceIPAddress,requestParameters
I'll gzip CSV and produce sha256. put in s3://redwood-auditor-exports/1836007777/kms-decrypts.csv.gz

omar_devops: I'll pull PD timeline and CI build logs that show deploys. CI writes `kubectl apply --record` so mapping should be straightforward. I'll also include the runbook excerpt that shows the step and executor.

sarah_auditor: auditors want checksums for each file and a README that explains redaction rules (mask IPs, truncate ARNs after account id, redact secrets). manifest columns: artifact_name,path,sha256,owner,produced_at.

laura_sec_eng: sample manifest row: pr_8271,https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8271,<sha256>,laura_sec_eng,2025-02-12T02:58Z
I'll also export pre/post rolebinding YAML with sha256.

mike_platform: KMS metadata: key alias alias/ci-encrypt, rotation enabled, keyId abcd-ef01-2345. CloudTrail raw path: s3://redwood-cloudtrail-logs/prod/2025/02/12/. I will mask source IPs to /24 in the redacted sample.

omar_devops: CI->deploy example: build 2025-02-12T03:47Z ran PR 8271, applied at 2025-02-12T03:48Z by ci-deployer. I'll include the exact log lines.

evidence-bot: packaging started. Steps: collect artifacts, redact PII, compute sha256, produce manifest.csv and README.txt, upload sample to staging.

sarah_auditor: redacted sample today is fine. final bundle must include raw logs (or redacted if secrets), plus checksums and mapping CSV. thank you. :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: redacted sample uploaded: s3://redwood-auditor-delivery/samples/1836007777-sample.tar.gz sha256: b1f2c3d4e5... Full bundle ETA tomorrow EOD.

laura_sec_eng: noted. will ping here when final upload completes.
